I teach graduate-level courses on statistical learning, econometrics, and financial risk management. Materials are linked where available.

## Courses

<span class="year">2025 – present</span>
<span class="title">Machine Learning: Support Vector Machines</span>
<div><span class="venue">M.Sc. in Econometrics and Applied Statistics (ESA), University of Orléans — Lecturer</span></div>
<span class="meta">Classification and regression, primal and dual formulations, soft-margin SVM, kernel methods, and practical applications in Python.</span>

::: {.entry}
<span class="year">2024 – present</span>
<span class="title">Climate Risk and Financial Risk Management</span>
<div><span class="venue">ENSAI and University of Bordeaux — Lecturer</span></div>
<span class="meta">Transmission channels from physical and transition climate risk to credit, market, and underwriting risk; implications for banking and insurance risk management and for regulatory climate stress-testing exercises.</span>
:::

::: {.entry}
<span class="year">2026 <span class="badge-soft">Forthcoming</span></span>
<span class="title">Deep Learning for Time Series</span>
<div><span class="venue">M.Sc. in Financial Engineering, Paris Dauphine University – PSL — Lecturer</span></div>
<span class="meta">Deep learning for time-series modelling and forecasting: recurrent and convolutional architectures, modern sequence models, attention-based methods, transformers, and recent implementations such as Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks.</span>

::: {.entry}
<span class="year">2026 <span class="badge-soft">Forthcoming</span></span>
<span class="title">Regularization Methods</span>
<div><span class="venue">M.Sc. in Applied Mathematics and Statistics (Financial Engineering), University of Bordeaux — Lecturer</span></div>
<span class="meta">Penalized regression, Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net, model selection, sparsity and shrinkage, the bias–variance trade-off, and practical implementation.</span>
